subject: Request: Temporary PO opt-out for ClarifyPay annual renewal
messages:
From: Natalie Kim <natalie@clarifypay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual subscription renewal — billing/PO question

Hi Alex,

Quick question on our upcoming annual renewal for ClarifyPay (account CLP-001): our finance team only issues POs on a quarterly cadence and they are unable to generate a PO keyed to an annual subscription at renewal time. We can provide an invoice and remit via ACH or wire on net-30 terms, but we won't have a Redwood PO number attached.

Is there a temporary invoice-only path for renewals while we update our procurement process? We expect the renewal to be <$50k for the first year. I've attached our renewal quote for reference.

Thanks,
Natalie Kim
Head of Finance, ClarifyPay
Natalie.Kim@clarifypay.com

Attachment: ClarifyPay_Renewal_Quote.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Kim <natalie@clarifypay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual subscription renewal — billing/PO question

Hi Natalie,

Thanks for the note and for sharing the quote. We can support a temporary invoice-only arrangement for renewals in certain cases — typically we need a short set of conditions satisfied so procurement can track the exception (proof of company details, a signed SOW/addendum and a limit on the amount).

Next steps I propose:
- I'll loop in our procurement lead (Lauren) to confirm the exception limits and required docs.
- Can you share ClarifyPay's W-9 (or local equivalent) and a billing contact?
- If you're able to sign a short addendum that confirms invoice-only terms for this renewal, that will speed approval. We can provide a DocuSign template.

I'll follow up with procurement and come back with the exact checklist today. Appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Team — forwarding ClarifyPay's request. Context: ClarifyPay is an existing customer, renewing an annual subscription (deal CLP-2026-0893). The renewal quote is attached (ClarifyPay_Renewal_Quote.xlsx) and the amount is estimated ~ $48k for year 1.

Proposed intake: grant a one-time invoice-only exception for this renewal under the following conditional controls (we can propose to the customer):
- Exception limit: up to $75,000 (to cover any small upsell)
- Documentation: W-9 + billing contact on file, signed addendum confirming invoice-only terms (we'll send DocuSign)
- Finance terms: net-30; payment via ACH/wire; invoice references ClarifyPay account number
- Security/compliance: ClarifyPay provided a short security brief (attached) stating SOC2 Type II in progress — want to confirm low vendor risk.

Can procurement confirm whether the above is acceptable, and if an exception can be routed without a PO for this renewal? If approved, I'll send the addendum and DocuSign link to the customer and confirm payment flow.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: ClarifyPay_Renewal_Quote.xlsx, ClarifyPay_Security_Brief.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Annual subscription renewal — ClarifyPay (request for PO opt-out)

Alex / Lauren,

Reviewed ClarifyPay's materials. Procurement is comfortable with a controlled invoice-only exception for this renewal under the following conditions:
1) Exception cap: $75,000
2) One-time approval for the current annual term only; any future renewals require either a purchase order or a renewed approval request
3) Signed addendum (DocuSign) that references the invoice-only arrangement and net-30 payment
4) Billing records: ClarifyPay must provide W-9 and a primary billing contact; finance to send remittance instructions on the invoice
5) Security follow-up: because SOC2 is in progress, send the ClarifyPay security brief to Security Ops for a quick intake; approval contingent on no red flags.

If those conditions are acceptable I'll sign off and procurement will document the exception. Note: please add deal id CLP-2026-0893 to the exception ticket.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Procurement Governance | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

- Documentation required: W-9 (or local equivalent) and a primary billing contact on file
- Signed addendum: please sign the attached DocuSign addendum which confirms the invoice-only terms and net-30 payment
- Security: we'll route the ClarifyPay security brief to Security Ops for a fast intake; any material concerns would pause the arrangement (we don't expect issues).
